recovery_conditioning: post-treatment descriptive; G bound is the fixed standardized probe
analysis_role: Exploratory post-hoc completed-A sensitivity; not a replacement for the original primary estimator.
selection_rule: Use the final terminal supplementary attempt for exactly the 117 pre-response quota-selected A pairs; retain every other original pair and all failures.
uncertainty_scope: Original scenario-stratified task-cluster bootstrap applied to a retrospectively assembled view; intervals condition on selected sources and do not remove collection-period effects.
